title: Expedition Atlas First Points and Route
summary: A cautious first-points checklist for the 0.5.4 Expedition Atlas, with all node names, effects, and routes still pending PC verification.
description: A source-linked checklist for reviewing the 0.5.4 Expedition Atlas before choosing a route.
prerequisites: Access to the current PC endgame Atlas interface
A saved copy of the official 0.5.4 and 0.5.4d announcements
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team

sections.title: Who this page is for
paragraphs: This page is for PC players who can access the current endgame Atlas and want a disciplined way to verify the Expedition Atlas before committing points. The official 0.5.4 preview identifies a Runes of Aldur Atlas Passive Tree and expanded Expedition customisation, but it does not justify copying a route from an unverified screenshot or older Patch guide.

sections.title: Before choosing a point
bullets: Confirm that the client is on the 0.5.4 baseline and record the installed Hotfix.
Open the Atlas in the PC client and capture the exact Expedition Atlas title, point total, node names, and node text.
Save the matching official announcement URL beside the capture. A community database can help discover a term, but it cannot replace the original source.
Check whether the character meets the current in-game unlock condition. Do not infer the condition from a previous Patch.

sections.title: Verification route for the first points

steps.label: Record available choices
body: Start by recording the available choices rather than allocating for a claimed "best" outcome.

steps.label: Document each candidate node
body: For each candidate node, record its exact text, the content it changes, and the intended test area.

steps.label: Test one change at a time
body: Test one change at a time in a repeatable Expedition or Grand Expedition context. Record the map/area, character state, and observed result.

steps.label: Compare with official notes
body: Compare the result with the official notes and mark any mismatch as under-review.

steps.label: Publish only after repeatability
body: Only after the observations are repeatable should a future published guide explain a route, its tradeoff, and the player profile it serves.

sections.title: Decisions this page does not make yet
paragraphs: This page does not name a required node order, a point total, a farming strategy, or an optimal reward target. Those conclusions require the current node text, a reproducible Steam PC test, and a stated build/gear context. They must also be revisited if a later official announcement lists a related interaction change; the cited 0.5.4d notes do not do so.

sections.title: Common mistakes to avoid
bullets: Treating a previous Patch's Atlas image as current evidence.
Assuming a node effect from its name instead of reading the live tooltip.
Combining several variables in one run and then claiming that one node caused the outcome.
Presenting a route as universal without recording its cost, build requirements, and failure cases.

sections.title: Sources and verification
paragraphs: Steam PC verification is pending. No node, point, route, or reward claim on this public page is marked as verified.
bullets: Path of Exile 2 official 0.5.4 Patch Preview — establishes the Expedition Atlas and Expedition customisation as 0.5.4 research scope.
Path of Exile 2 official 0.5.4 Patch Notes — records that Atlas points come from each Boss in The Grand Expedition questline.
Path of Exile 2 official 0.5.4d Patch Notes — records the client version separately and does not establish an Atlas change.
